origin.title: Origin
origin.quote: I'd rather be a cyborg than a goddess. — Donna Haraway
origin.body:
I learned to read space before I learned to read code. In dance, the body is an interface: it receives, processes, responds. There is no separation between the machine and the one who inhabits it: there is system, there is rhythm, there is consequence.

Today I build with React and Three.js what I once built with movement. I design products and interfaces where technology does not interrupt: it accompanies. Immersive experiences that are not explained, but inhabited.

Movement taught me that form follows intention. Code taught me that intention needs structure in order to exist.

I work at that threshold: where body and machine stop being opposites.
